# Beanis

> Async Pydantic ODM for plain Redis: documents as hashes, secondary indexes, vector search on Redis 8 vector sets, and long-term memory for AI agents (Python API, `beanis` CLI, `beanis-mcp` MCP server, Claude Code plugin). Not Beanie: no query builder; `find()` takes keyword filters on indexed fields.

Install: `pip install beanis` (ODM) or `pip install "beanis[mcp]"` (adds the CLI memory commands and MCP server; Python 3.10+). Needs Redis 5+, and Redis 8.0+ for vector search and memory.

- [API reference for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andreim14/beanis/main/plugins/beanis/skills/beanis/SKILL.md): models, indexes, CRUD, find, vector_search, Memory, CLI. Follow this over older tutorials.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andreim14/beanis/main/README.md): overview, install, examples, MCP setup.
